review.rationale: WEB.40 successor of web-40-admission-r15 for the S20(a) Site release asset (CLOUD.85 decisions D2 option A and D3). The one bound input that changed is .github/workflows/ci.yml: the main-push release now publishes web-site-<sha256>.tar beside web-profiles, guarded so that exactly one Site archive is in the sealed candidate. The Site archive is a deterministic root member of the candidate, sealed by its digest and verified byte for byte against the regenerated Site; it is not part of the Cloudflare assets directory. The profile bundle drops the shell's precompressed siblings (index.html.br, index.html.gz) from the root. No other bound input changed: the csproj files, packages.lock.json files, props, global.json, package.json, package-lock.json, wrangler.json, .node-version, .npmrc, NuGet.config and the browser-resources profile and record r11 and r12 keep their digests. Reviewer w-deku-20261008-rev-web-40; reviewed base efe787254ae64cc8027a6b801b3cbd9080481321. No package, version, source, licence, contentHash, nuspecSha256, closure coordinate or scanner exception changed: packages, scannerExceptions, packsFolderRows, con07Identity, browserWasmPacks, nugetClosure and nugetPackDownloads are copied from r15 unchanged. r15 is not edited. Verification is local only: the local Node is 24.20 against the 24.21 pin, and actionlint, gitleaks and Docker are not installed; the hosted quality and csharp jobs at the exact head are the authority, and the exact-head review by w-deku-20261008-rev-web-40 remains a merge condition.
review.runtimeAssessment: The deployed public candidate is the C# static Site with no runtime JavaScript; the Worker stays the thin TypeScript adapter (worker/index.ts), emitted by Node type stripping. Node remains build and deploy tooling for wrangler only. The candidate job enforces the Blazor profile budgets and seals the Site and its Site archive; the deploy job ships the same sealed bytes under the unchanged main-push guards, and the Site archive is a release asset only, never a deployed asset. No hosted browser, device, macOS or live-service check is added.

packsFolderRows.reason: The hosted windows-2025-vs2026 image (runner image 20260925.250.1, CI job 113727560820) preinstalls the wasm.tools workload into C:\Program Files\dotnet, which holds this pack at the bundled version 10.0.12 (the same run's build lists the 10.0.12 Emscripten workload packs in that folder), so the SDK adds no NuGet download. A local machine whose packs folder lacks 10.0.12 restores the NuGet copy and it is verified by digest there.

The Ubuntu hosted image carries no WebAssembly workload, so this row is checked there and not satisfied: the SDK adds the implicit pack as a NuGet download, restores it and the test verifies its digest. The NuGet copy is skipped only when a 10.0.12 packs copy with the marker exists locally, and in that case the SDK does not download the pack either.
